lang_code.description: The language code to match for font substitution (e.g., 'dv' for Divehi/Dhivehi).

target_family.description: The generic font family name to target for substitution.

font_family_name.description: The specific font family name to prepend or alias.

enable_hinting.description: Whether to append 'false' to the fonthashint property, disabling hinting.
